cards.example: I feel lonely because I need connection.
I feel out of place because I need belonging.
I feel isolated because I need companionship.
I feel distant because I need intimacy.
I feel overwhelmed because I need support.
I feel frustrated because I need understanding.
I feel alone in this because I need empathy.
I feel unseen because I need appreciation.
I feel trapped because I need choice.
I feel stifled because I need freedom.
I feel crowded because I need space.
I feel bored by the routine because I need spontaneity.
I feel uneasy because I need honesty.
I feel disconnected from myself because I need authenticity.
I feel dull because I need play.
I feel flat because I need joy.
I feel agitated because I need peace.
I feel tense because I need harmony.
I feel strained because I need ease.
I feel exhausted because I need rest.
I feel stiff because I need movement.
I feel on edge because I need safety.
I feel confused because I need clarity.
I feel empty because I need meaning.
I feel adrift because I need purpose.
I feel useless because I need contribution.
I feel stuck because I need growth.
I feel blocked because I need creativity.
I feel suspicious because I need trust.
I feel dismissed because I need respect.
